meta.heading: Cavalry against a halberd screen guarding the guns
meta.challenge: Six mounted units face eight enemy units: four halberd units screening two units of handgunners and a cannon. Halberds are built to stop cavalry, so a frontal charge into them risks a losing grind; the gunners behind them are weak in melee. The attacker must defeat the defenders before the 20-minute timer runs out.
meta.game_speed: unpaused, 1x (the battle kept running while the model replied)

semantics.coordinates: metres; x grows east, z grows north; draw north up (screen y = -z)
semantics.samples: 483 recorder frames (about 1 per battle second) merged with the decision-basis observations; positions never interpolated
semantics.pos: per unit, one entry per sample: [x, z, men, flags] (+ hp 0-1 for single-figure units) or null; flags: 1 = in melee, 2 = fleeing (routing or shattered)
semantics.enemy_visibility: an enemy entry exists only while the unit was visible to the model's army; null = not visible or destroyed
semantics.model_view: at playback time T, the observation behind the latest decision with t <= T (empty replies included): samples[obs_i], age T - obs_t
semantics.decision_t: t = battle time the game acknowledged the reply's orders; obs_t = battle time of the observation the model was given
semantics.orders: issued orders and their acknowledgement; acknowledged is not proof the order was carried out. Issued routes ('to') are distinct from observed movement
semantics.reply: the model's stated reason from its structured reply, verbatim; not access to hidden reasoning. It names units by raw id (f1 = model, e1 = AI); see units
semantics.memo: present when the reply rewrote the model's own battle notes (its memory between replies), verbatim
semantics.notes: analyst interpretations drafted after the battle with AI assistance and checked against the recorded events; not the model's words

bounds.basis: the report's framing: 5th-95th percentile of recorded positions and starting positions, 50 m margin

terrain.about: rows[j][i] is the cell centred at (x0 + i*cell_m, z0 + j*cell_m); row 0 is the southern edge. '#' = a sample_width_m square failed the engine's is_area_clear test at deployment (restricted), '.' = clear. Coarse, not a path planner

notes.title: The guns break first
notes.text: Following its stated plan to go “around the south side of the central obstruction to approach the enemy flank”, the cavalry reached the gun line and fought there: Handgunners 2 began fleeing at 3:06, the Great Cannons at 3:20 and Handgunners 1 at 3:56.
notes.label: Analyst note (interpretation, written after the battle)

notes.title: Pressing the halberd line to the end
notes.text: After the guns broke, the halberd line gave way one unit at a time, Halberdiers 4 at 5:12, the General at 5:40, Halberdiers 2 at 5:50 (it rallied at 6:11), Halberdiers 1 at 7:17 and Halberdiers 3 at 8:07, when Halberdiers 2 was also seen fleeing and the game declared the win, while three of the four knight regiments had begun fleeing by 7:59.
